changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO brand_categories (brand_id, category_id) SELECT b.id, c.id FROM brands b, categories c WHERE c.code = 'Mobil_telefonlar' AND b.slug IN ('apple','samsung','xiaomi','huawei','nokia','honor','oneplus','poco','redmi','realme','oppo','vivo','meizu','lg','motorola','sony-ericsson','blackberry','htc','google','nothing','zte','infinix','tecno','artel','fly','explay','erisson','bbk','bravis','inoi','iru','philips','sony','panasonic','tcl','asus','lenovo','desten','general','assistant') ON CONFLICT (brand_id, category_id) DO NOTHING;
